public_transcript_audit.finding: The public machine-transcript index exposes June 5, 12, 19 and 26 MATI transcript links and later episodes through July 10 in the visible 2026 run. The current accessible index did not expose a July 24 transcript body, and targeted web searches did not independently recover a Josh Moloch/Molach/Molech quotation.
public_transcript_audit.limitation: The transcript bodies were not retrievable through the current web/cache environment, so absence from search is not proof the phrase was never spoken.

candidate_explanations.description: A June MATI utterance may exist and have been revived later. June recordings/transcript links survive, but no exact Moloch excerpt has yet been recovered.
The underlying remark may be in the July 24 MATI stream and may have reached Tim directly or through the July 27 clipping/reaction wave.

Tim's later phrase may combine an underlying personal/family-sacrifice reading with separate government/fed discourse and Tim's already-existing Moloch/sacrifice symbolic vocabulary. This is a provenance hypothesis, not a psychological diagnosis.
A short explicit Moloch clip may have existed but be deleted, poorly indexed or mirrored under an unrelated title.

prediction_assessment.why: The architecture and Josh linkage precede the alleged later convergence, but the archive lacks an exact pre-event Josh-specific future statement and lacks the exact later Josh quote.

upgrade_conditions: Recover exact pre-July-24 Tim wording naming Josh with Moloch/sacrifice/sold-soul or an equivalent later-repeated motif.
Recover a pre-July-24 future-tense Tim statement predicting what Josh would say/reveal.
Recover the primary July 24 or earlier MATI excerpt and compare exact wording/context.
Recover the exact primary July 8 Tim turn to determine whether the Josh/Farm/debt bridge is stronger than the current summary.
epistemic_rule: Prior symbolic vocabulary and named-entity relational placement can establish precedence and make later convergence historically interesting. It becomes a prior-specific prediction only if an earlier statement specifies the later Josh event/referent tightly enough to test, and the later event itself is independently recovered.
